pipeline.label: Scan 10⁷ candidates by recomputing gradients
pipeline.why: dense backprop, the bill itself; one ET card is 21–35× slower and spends 1.8–3.0× the energy

pipeline.label: Build a sketch index of 10⁷ gradients
pipeline.why: dense backprop plus a projection; the sparse sketches would need 16 GB per sequence over a 15.75 GB/s link

pipeline.label: Exact rerank of the top 10⁴ at 70B
pipeline.why: 10⁴ fresh gradients; with an EK-FAC iHVP it is over 99.9% of a query's energy

pipeline.label: Query gradients, 100 queries
pipeline.why: dense backprop; an 8B model in fp16 does not fit one card's 32 GB comfortably, and there is no bf16

pipeline.label: Eigendecompose the Kronecker factors
pipeline.why: needs fp64 (the chip has none, and no hardware divide or square root); factors up to 14,336² (0.8 GB in fp32, 1.6 GB in fp64) exceed the chip's scratchpads (72 MB usable of 80 MB)

pipeline.label: EK-FAC iHVP (1.06 s)
pipeline.why: compute-bound matmuls against 108 GB of resident bases: 1,500 chips of SRAM to keep them on chip

pipeline.label: Stream the whole 82 GB sketch index, 1 query
pipeline.why: bandwidth-bound: the ET's DRAM gives 76 GB/s at 133 pJ/B above idle, 44× slower than HBM, and holds 32 GB

pipeline.label: Lexical prefilter (BM25/TF-IDF)
pipeline.why: ET-shaped (per-core document ownership, no atomics) but about 10⁻⁶ of the bill; the host CPU's inverted index does it

pipeline.label: Scatter the gradients' sparse parts into sketches
pipeline.per: per batch of 100 queries (at most 1% of the scan)
pipeline.why: the one ET-shaped step with real size, but the data is born in the GPU's backward pass (16 GB per sequence would have to cross a 15.75 GB/s link); GPUs keep the buckets in L2 or avoid the scatter; the chip's scatter-add, measured since (S3), reaches 10 G updates a second only while the buckets stay in a shire, and runs at 0.42 G/s into DRAM

pipeline.label: Score a static 65 MB shard, 1 query (S1)
pipeline.why: the one physical edge: 4.4 pJ/B from the chip's own scratchpad; no time win, and it needs a busy card

pipeline.label: Select the top k (fused into scoring)
pipeline.why: 10⁴–1.5×10⁵ heap inserts per query even at N = 10¹⁰: free in a GPU kernel's epilogue; kept only as part of S1
